] Items multiselect\n  - [ ] `yellow_threshold` (float parsing)\n  - [ ] `red_threshold` (float parsing)\n  - [ ] `direction` fixed/locked to `higher_is_worse` (hidden or server-validated invariant)\n- [ ] Implement persistence/serialization hooks for the framework.\n- [ ] Implement refresh-time validation and cover selection:\n  - [ ] at least one item selected\n  - [ ] thresholds numeric parsing\n  - [ ] `red_threshold >= yellow_threshold`\n  - [ ] all items exist and are accessible\n  - [ ] all items supported numeric types (float + unsigned int or documented subset)\n- [ ] Implement latest numeric value retrieval for each configured item.\n- [ ] Implement per-item evaluation (inclusive, higher_is_worse).\n- [ ] Implement worst-state-wins aggregation.\n- [ ] Return a single aggregated state payload for rendering (green/yellow/red) and standard reason/debug metadata if supported.\n\n### Frontend\n- [ ] Implement/verify widget rendering uses the framework’s standard widget rendering + standard cover UI.\n- [ ] Ensure add/edit UI supports multiselect of items and threshold input fields.\n- [ ] Ensure direction is not user-editable (or is rejected server-side).\n\n### Testing\n- [ ] Unit tests for:\n  - [ ] inclusive comparisons at exact threshold values\n  - [ ] aggregation worst-state-wins across combinations\n- [ ] Integration/API tests for refresh handler:\n  - [ ] invalid config thresholds => INVALID_CONFIG cover\n  - [ ] empty selection => empty/no-items cover\n  - [ ] permission-lost items => permission/inaccessible cover\n  - [ ] unsupported item types => unsupported-items cover\n  - [ ] missing latest values => no-data cover\n- [ ] Persistence test:\n  - [ ] save → reload dashboard → verify config restored and refresh works\n- [ ] Manual verification: Add widget via dashboard picker, configure multiselect + thresholds, confirm traffic-light state transitions at inclusive boundaries.\n- [ ] Manual verification: Modify user permissions to remove access to one configured item, refresh, and confirm correct standard cover with no data leakage.\n- [ ] Manual verification: Configure widget with an unsupported numeric item type and confirm the standard unsupported-items cover.\n- [ ] Manual verification: Create a scenario with no latest value for one selected item (per framework definition) and confirm the standard no-data cover.\n\n## Verification\n- Automated verification (CI/tooling-dependent):\n  - Run unit/integration tests added for widget evaluation semantics and validation/cover mapping.\n  - Validate persistence serialization/deserialization with existing widget framework test harness.\n- Manual verification:\n  - Confirm UI widget picker registration and the add/edit/save/load/refresh flows behave as expected.\n  - Visually confirm the widget shows exactly one traffic-light state (not per-item) and matches worst-state-wins.\n  - Confirm inclusive boundary semantics by testing values exactly at thresholds.\n\n## Documentation Impact\n- [ ] Add/update widget documentation entry for the new widget (under existing dashboard widget documentation) including:\n  - supported item types (float and unsigned integer, or narrower subset enforced by the framework)\n  - fixed MVP semantics: `higher_is_worse`, inclusive, worst-state-wins\n  - explanation of aggregated behavior\n- [ ] If the framework enforces a narrower subset of numeric types, document that explicitly in implementation notes and/or widget docs.\n- [ ] If there is a widget registry/overview list, register the new widget id, config fields, and output semantics.\n\n## Suggested Diagram\n```puml\n@startuml\nleft to right direction\nskinparam ParticipantPadding 20\nskinparam BoxPadding 10\nskinparam ArrowColor #333\n\nactor User\nparticipant \"Dashboard widget framework\\n(widget refresh route)\" as Framework\nparticipant \"WorstStateNumericWidget (PHP)\" as Widget\ndatabase \"Items DB (latest numeric value)\" as ItemsDB\n\nUser -> Framework : Request widget refresh/view\nFramework -> Widget : refresh(config, userCtx)\n\nalt invalid widget config (parse/ordering/rules)\n  Widget -> Framework : Return standard cover\\nINVALID_CONFIG\nelse empty selection (no itemids)\n  Widget -> Framework : Return standard cover\\nEMPTY / NO_ITEMS\nelse resolve configured itemids\n  Widget -> Widget : Validate thresholds floats\\nEnsure red_threshold >= yellow_threshold\\n(upper is worse; inclusive)\n  Widget -> Widget : Resolve itemids accessible to user\n  alt permission loss/inaccessible items\n    Widget -> Framework : Return standard cover\\nPERMISSION / INACCESSIBLE\n  else supported numeric item types\n    Widget -> Widget : Filter/verify supported numeric types\\n(float, unsigned int subset)\n    alt unsupported items present\n      Widget -> Framework : Return standard cover\\nUNSUPPORTED_ITEMS\n    else fetch latest values per item\n      Widget -> ItemsDB : Get latest numeric value per itemid\n      alt no data / missing value\n        Widget -> Framework : Return standard cover\\nNO_DATA\n      else evaluate per-item MVP semantics\n        Widget -> Widget : For each item:\n        - red if value >= red_threshold\n        - else yellow if value >= yellow_threshold\n        - else green\n        - include reason metadata\n        Widget -> Widget : Aggregate worst-state-wins:\n        any red -> red\n        else any yellow -> yellow\n        else green\n      end\n      Widget -> Framework : Return traffic-light payload\\n(state=G/Y/R)\n    end\n  end\nend\n\nFramework -> User : Render widget UI\\n- traffic-light HTML\\n- or standard cover\n@enduml\n```",

On refresh, the widget evaluates each selected item’s latest numeric value using fixed MVP semantics (**higher_is_worse**, **worst-state-wins**, inclusive boundaries) and renders **one aggregated traffic-light** state (green/yellow/red).\n\n**MVP semantics (fixed):**\n- Aggregation mode: `worst-state-wins`\n  - any red => widget red\n  - else any yellow => widget yellow\n  - else all green => widget green\n- Threshold direction: `higher_is_worse`\n- Boundary behavior: inclusive comparisons\n- Per-item evaluation (inclusive, higher_is_worse):\n  - `value >= red_threshold` => per-item **red**\n  - else `value >= yellow_threshold` => per-item **yellow**\n  - else => per-item **green**\n\nSupported items (enforced by implementation notes/widget framework):\n- numeric items only; specifically **float** and **unsigned integer** (or the narrower subset enforced by the widget framework—**document explicitly in implementation notes**).\n\nWidget must integrate with the existing dashboard widget framework lifecycle (picker + add/edit/save/load + permission-aware render/refresh + persistence) and must use **standard widget covers** (no custom partial UI) for:\n- invalid configuration\n- empty selection\n- permission loss / inaccessible items\n- unsupported items\n- no-data conditions\n\n## Scope\nIn scope:\n1. Create one new widget type in the existing PHP UI widget framework under:\n   - `ui/widgets/<new_widget_id>/`\n2. Register it so it appears in the dashboard widget picker and participates in all standard widget flows:\n   - add/edit/save/load\n   - permission-aware render/refresh\n   - persistence/serialization\n3. Implement configuration fields:\n   - widget title/name (standard framework field)\n   - multiselect of **one or more items**\n   - shared `yellow_threshold` (numeric/float input)\n   - shared `red_threshold` (numeric/float input)\n   - `direction` is fixed to `higher_is_worse` (either hidden or validated server-side as invariant per framework conventions)\n4. Implement server-side validation during render/refresh (and optionally save-time if supported):\n   - threshold parsing as numeric (float)\n   - enforce ordering compatible with `higher_is_worse`:\n     - require `red_threshold >= yellow_threshold` (inclusive boundaries; equality allowed)\n   - ignore/deny any client-provided direction to keep invariant `higher_is_worse`\n5. Implement per-item evaluation and aggregation on refresh:\n   - resolve configured item ids with permission checks\n   - fetch each item’s latest numeric value\n   - map each to per-item state via inclusive comparisons\n   - aggregate via worst-state-wins\n\nOut of scope (for this single backlog item):\n- additional aggregation modes other than `worst-state-wins`\n- configurable `direction` or switching threshold direction semantics\n- custom non-standard widget UI components beyond the framework’s standard traffic-light/cover rendering\n\n## System Changes\nBackend (PHP, widget framework integration):\n- Add new widget backend under `ui/widgets/<new_widget_id>/`:\n  - manifest/registration entry so the widget is discoverable in picker\n  - server widget controller/view implementation consistent with existing widget framework conventions\n  - endpoints/handlers required by the widget framework for refresh and persistence\n- Configuration handling & persistence:\n  - store and reload title, selected item ids, `yellow_threshold`, `red_threshold`\n  - persist multiselect selection\n- Validation/invariants on refresh/render:\n  - parse thresholds as float\n  - validate `red_threshold >= yellow_threshold`\n  - enforce `direction = higher_is_worse` as invariant (server-side)\n  - validate selected items are supported numeric types (float + unsigned integer, or narrower enforced subset; explicitly document)\n- Permission-aware item resolution:\n  - load configured items using existing permission-aware utilities\n  - inaccessible items must not leak values; selection may become empty post-filter\n- Data retrieval:\n  - fetch each resolved item’s latest numeric value using the framework’s established “latest data point” pattern\n  - robust numeric extraction/conversion with framework-consistent no-data handling\n- State computation:\n  - per-item:\n    - `value >= red_threshold` => red\n    - else if `value >= yellow_threshold` => yellow\n    - else green\n  - aggregation:\n    - any red => aggregated red\n    - else any yellow => aggregated yellow\n    - else green\n- Standard cover usage (no custom partial UI):\n  - invalid config\n  - empty selection (including after permission filter)\n  - permission loss/inaccessible items\n  - unsupported items\n  - no-data conditions\n\nFrontend/Assets (framework-compatible):\n- Implement widget frontend assets only as required by the framework:\n  - render aggregated traffic-light state using the framework’s standard HTML/CSS/state mechanism\n  - use the framework’s standard covers for error/empty/permission/no-data cases\n- Widget configuration UI:\n  - title/name uses standard widget field\n  - item multiselect picker uses framework standard picker component\n  - numeric input fields for `yellow_threshold` and `red_threshold`\n  - `direction` not user-editable (hide or enforce as invariant)\n\nSuggested PlantUML diagram is included in “Suggested Diagram”.\n\n## Acceptance Criteria\n- The widget appears in the dashboard widget picker and can be added/configured/saved via the standard widget framework flows.\n- Selecting **1+ supported numeric items** and configuring thresholds results in exactly **one aggregated traffic-light** state on refresh.\n- Inclusive boundary behavior is correct:\n  - value exactly equal to `yellow_threshold` => yellow\n  - value exactly equal to `red_threshold` => red\n- Aggregation semantics are correct:\n  - any red among items => aggregated red\n  - else any yellow => aggregated yellow\n  - else green\n- Direction semantics are fixed to `higher_is_worse`:\n  - any attempt to override direction client-side is ignored/rejected server-side\n- The widget renders **standard framework covers** for:\n  - invalid configuration\n  - empty selection\n  - permission loss / inaccessible items\n  - unsupported items\n  - no-data conditions\n- Permissions are enforced:\n  - inaccessible items do not leak values\n  - resulting behavior matches framework cover conventions\n- Widget configuration persists and reloads correctly when dashboards are reopened.\n\n## Implementation Checklist\n### Backend\n- [ ] Create `ui/widgets/<new_widget_id>/` with required widget backend entry points (controller/view, config handler, refresh handler) following existing framework patterns.\n- [ ] Register the widget in the widget manifest system so it appears in the picker.\n- [ ] Implement config schema handling:\n  - title/name (standard)\n  - multiselect item ids\n  - `yellow_threshold` and `red_threshold` parsing as float\n  - invariant enforcement: direction fixed to `higher_is_worse`\n- [ ] Implement validation:\n  - reject invalid/NaN thresholds\n  - enforce `red_threshold >= yellow_threshold`\n  - enforce supported numeric item types (document exact allowed types in implementation notes)\n- [ ] Implement permission-aware item resolution:\n  - filter item ids by user permissions\n  - if resolved set is empty after filtering => standard cover per framework convention\n- [ ] Implement latest numeric value fetching per resolved item.\n- [ ] Implement per-item state mapping with inclusive comparisons.\n- [ ] Implement worst-state-wins aggregation.\n- [ ] Implement standard cover selection logic for:\n  - invalid config / empty selection / unsupported items / no-data / permission-filtered emptiness.\n- [ ] Ensure persistence roundtrip: save => reload => refresh computes same aggregated state.\n\n### Frontend\n- [ ] Add widget frontend assets under `ui/widgets/<new_widget_id>/assets/` if the framework requires it.\n- [ ] Ensure the widget renders aggregated state using the framework’s standard traffic-light state rendering (no custom partial UI).\n- [ ] Ensure the widget configuration form uses framework-standard controls:\n  - item multiselect\n  - numeric inputs for thresholds\n  - title/name field\n- [ ] Ensure `direction` is not editable (or is ignored/blocked server-side).\n- [ ] Wire refresh response handling to update only the aggregated traffic-light state.\n\n### Testing\n- [ ] Unit tests (PHP) for:\n  - threshold parsing and validation (`red_threshold >= yellow_threshold`)\n  - per-item inclusive mapping at exact boundaries\n  - worst-state-wins aggregation correctness\n- [ ] Integration/API tests for:\n  - refresh endpoint computing aggregated state from seeded item values\n  - behavior when permission filtering removes all selected items\n  - behavior when selected items include unsupported numeric types\n  - behavior when items have no latest value (no-data)\n- [ ] UI behavior tests (if repo has UI test harness):\n  - aggregated traffic-light updates on refresh\n  - correct CSS/state classes for green/yellow/red\n- [ ] Manual verification:\n  - Manual verification: Add the widget to a dashboard and configure 2–3 items with values around thresholds; verify inclusive boundaries.\n  - Manual verification: Set one item to meet red and ensure aggregated state becomes red regardless of other items.\n  - Manual verification: Change user permissions so selected items become inaccessible; verify the standard permission/no-data/empty cover behavior.\n  - Manual verification: Attempt to select unsupported item types (or simulate via backend); verify unsupported-item cover.\n\n## Verification\n- Automated verification (runner-friendly):\n  - the exact supported numeric item type enforcement and where it is applied\n  - cover behavior mapping to framework conventions\n\n## Suggested Diagram\n```puml\n@startuml\nleft to right direction\nactor \"Dashboard\" as Dash\nparticipant \"WidgetView (PHP)\") as WidgetView\nparticipant \"Config validation (server)\" as Validate\nparticipant \"Item resolver + permissions\" as Resolve\nparticipant \"Numeric fetch (latest value)\" as Fetch\nparticipant \"Per-item state mapping\" as MapState\nparticipant \"Aggregation (worst-state-wins)\" as Aggregate\nparticipant \"Render (traffic-light / cover)\" as Render\n\nDash -> WidgetView : refresh(widget_id, persisted_config)\nWidgetView -> Validate : validate thresholds + invariants\nValidate : enforce direction = higher_is_worse\nValidate : inclusive bounds\nValidate : require red_threshold >= yellow_threshold\nValidate : validate selected items are supported numeric\n\nalt invalid config/empty selection/unsupported items/no-data\n  WidgetView -> Render : standard cover (invalid/empty/unsupported/no-data)\nelse valid\n  WidgetView -> Resolve : load configured item ids with permission checks\n  Resolve : filter inaccessible items\n\n  alt after permission filter selection empty\n    WidgetView -> Render : standard cover (no-data/inaccessible)\n  else\n    WidgetView -> Fetch : fetch latest numeric value per item\n    Fetch -> MapState : values\n    MapState : per item:\n    MapState : if value >= red_threshold => red\n    MapState : else if value >= yellow_threshold => yellow\n    MapState : else => green\n\n    MapState -> Aggregate : per-item states\n    Aggregate : worst-state-wins\n    Aggregate : any red => red\n    Aggregate : else any yellow => yellow\n    Aggregate : else => green\n\n    Aggregate -> WidgetView : aggregated_state (green/yellow/red)\n    WidgetView -> Render : render traffic-light container/state\n  end\nend\n@enduml\n```",
